    GOMOKU STUDIO / 12.0.1

    Local-first play, guided practice and private studies. Optional accounts and online play require your own hosted server.

    A NEW BOARD

    Choose your game.

    Three-stone starts are teaching setups, not a rated opening book. Starting a new game replaces the autosave; save or export the current game to keep it.

    Board preferences

    Influence is proximity only, not territory, a score, or a win probability.

    Rules & keyboard reference

    Use arrows to move around the board, Enter or Space to place. Home/End reaches the edge of a row. Ctrl+Home/End reaches a corner. Outside text fields: U undo, Y redo, H hint, R review, F focus. Escape cancels a search or exits focus mode.

    All modes use a 15 × 15 board. Renju forbids Black overlines, double-fours and genuine double-threes; White is unrestricted by those fouls. Opening and swap procedures are separate tools and are not applied to the main-board Renju ruleset. Optional clocks restore paused.

    Reduced-motion preferences are respected automatically. Small mobile intersections have a separate 44-pixel Place control for confirmation.
